insert into employee_schedule (id, clinic_id, employee_id, schedule_id, work_date, crt_id, crt_name, crt_time, upd_id, upd_name, upd_time, inservice) VALUES
(#{item.id,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{item.clinicId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.employeeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.scheduleId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.workDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{item.crtId,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{item.crtName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.crtTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{item.updId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.updName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.updTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{item.inservice,jdbcType=BIT})
mapper.select:
select es.id, es.employee_id, es.clinic_id, es.work_date, es.schedule_id, bs.type, bs.name, bs.first_start_time, bs.first_end_time, bs.second_start_time, bs.second_end_time from employee_schedule es left join base_schedule bs on es.schedule_id = bs.id
bs.type = '上班'
and es.employee_id in
#{item}
and DATE_FORMAT(es.work_date,'%Y-%m-%d') in
DATE_FORMAT(#{item},'%Y-%m-%d')
order by bs.first_start_time asc;

select bs.name, bs.type, bs.first_start_time as firstStartTime, bs.first_end_time as firstEndTime, bs.second_start_time as secondStartTime, bs.second_end_time as secondEndTime, bs.inservice from base_schedule bs left join employee_schedule es on bs.id=es.schedule_id where es.id = #{id}
